import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Plot a bar chart to show the survival rate based on class
class_survival = df['survived'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(x=class_survival.index, y=class_survival.values, palette='Blues_d')
plt.title('Survival Rate Based on Class')
plt.xlabel('Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Count')
plt.legend(title='Class')
plt.savefig('output_class_survival.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot a pie chart to show the survival rate based on sex
sex_survival = df['sex'].map({'male': 0, 'female': 1})['survived'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.pie(sex_survival.values, labels=sex_survival.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=['lightblue', 'lightgreen'])
plt.title('Survival Rate Based on Sex')
plt.axis('equal')
plt.savefig('output_sex_survival.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot a histogram to show the age distribution of survivors and non-survivors
age_histogram = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].hist(bins=20, alpha=0.5, label='Survivors')
df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].hist(bins=20, alpha=0.5, label='Non-Survivors', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('Age Distribution of Survivors and Non-Survivors')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('output_age_distribution.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot a scatter plot to show the relationship between fare and survival
fare_scatter = df[['fare', 'survived']].dropna()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='fare', y='survived', data=fare_scatter)
plt.title('Relationship Between Fare and Survival')
plt.xlabel('Fare')
plt.ylabel('Survival')
plt.legend(title='Survival')
plt.savefig('output_fare_scatter.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
